## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (75%)** · Ambiguous: InSitu vs Benign · Careful review
The 90% conformal set includes both InSitu and Benign (21%) on a simulated frozen section [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 75%, Benign 21%, Invasive 3%, Normal 2% (ECE 5%) | Favors InSitu; low invasive risk |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu at 90% target (90% test coverage) | Cannot exclude a benign lesion |
| Reliability / OOD | 96% reliability, OOD percentile 1.0, 12/12 regions kept [F6] | Input passes quality check |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent backbones concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 InSitu (70%–79% similarity) [F5] | Reference neighbors match suggestion |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 0, 7, 9) · context · Above-typical score (-0.81 weight away from invasive; 8/20 AI spot check) [F2] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 0) · ↑ invasive · Typical score (+0.34 weight), but failed AI spot check (0/20) [F3] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Low slide-wide score (+0.33 weight toward invasive; 20/20 spot check) [F4] · Validated
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 1, 2, 5) · ↑ invasive · High concept score (+0.30 weight), but failed AI spot check (3/20) · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 10) · ↑ invasive · Strongest in highest-risk region (+0.16 weight; 19/20 AI spot check) · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions drops invasive score above random (95% CI 0.002 to 0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unverified (CI -0.009 to 0.006 includes 0); leans on unreliable normal lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20), and mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Lesion is a benign mimic (`BACH_0230`, 63% similar) or obscured by simulated frozen-section JPEG artifacts; deeper levels drafted.
- Focal invasion exists in region 10 (58% regional risk), or lateral/superior edges are involved despite clear margin call [F7].

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 10**: Highest regional invasive risk (58%) and validated stromal infiltration score; rule out focal invasion.
2. **Regions 1, 5**: Next highest risk (6% each) with duct-confined atypia; distinguish InSitu from Benign on deeper levels.
3. **Regions 0, 7, 9**: Assess lymphocytic infiltrate and inspect lateral/superior margins (segment scores up to 100%).
